answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 5561 Country: Bangladesh Title: Now a days, cockroaches are disturbing a lot. They are all around the house, specially in the kitchen. So, I started killing them wherever they are found, not only in our house. Am I doing crime killing a creature of Allah Subhana Wa Ta'la ? If not, then will it be a sin if I leave them alive? What is about killing other insects like mice, ants, mosquito etc.? What limit should we follow in killing or leaving them alive? Question: Assalamu-alaikum, Now a days, cockroaches are disturbing a lot. They are all around the house, specially in the kitchen. So, I started killing them wherever they are found, not only in our house. Am I doing crime killing a creature of Allah Subhana Wa Ta'la ? If not, then will it be a sin if I leave them alive? What is about killing other insects like mice, ants, mosquito etc.? What limit should we follow in killing or leaving them alive? Zazakallahu Khairan. Answer ID: 5561 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 707/592=B) Yes, killing cockroach is allowed. The mice/rats, ants, lizards can be poisoned to death. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
